brief: Large drive-in granary and implement building about 30 ft by 40 ft (the middle building of the example view): unpainted vertical boards weathered silver-brown, a tall central gable with a steep pale-grey steel roof that breaks to a shallower pitch over lean-to aisles on both sides (a broken-gable plains granary profile), a small window high in the gable and wide doors at grade. It stands between the red gambrel barn and a long grey sheep shed on a grassy hilltop. (Granary used as machine storage; nearest vocabulary type is frame_machine_shed.)
